limitations: 5CSEBA6U23I7 is a provisional capacity target, not board truth.

I/O mode is recorded per row. Ordinary leaf fits use virtual top ports; an explicit -PhysicalPins characterization wrapper retains its small top boundary as physical pins. Neither mode assigns board pins, board I/O delays, or PLLs.
A per-block fit does not characterize the composed machine routing or timing closure.
Rows carry their own sourceCommit. A row measured at an older commit describes THAT code, not HEAD. Check per-row provenance before totalling anything.
This census does not cover the design: 42 of the repository's 88 RTL modules, and several of those rows carry no data. See reports/DSP_Audit_2026-08-21.md.

The composed fit is NOT blocked on machine memory. The 28.4 GB figure once recorded here was a wildcard virtual-pin bug fixed in d1a2b8a; composed synthesis completes in 42:33 at a 6.2 GB peak (f3506b6). The second half of this note -- that it is blocked on zhao_cmd_dma's 156 dependent CRC steps -- is STALE as of 2026-09-18 and is kept only so the claim can be found and not repeated. It cited reports/REMAINING_BLOCKERS.md, last touched 2026-08-28; zhao_cmd_dma has been reworked twice since (59de7ca7, 1bfca734) and its header CRC and payload seed are now WALKED eight bytes per cycle through one zhao_crc32c_fold, four cycles each, rather than swept as one 224-XOR-level chain. Whether it still binds the composed cone is a question for a composed timing report, not for this string.
Rows carrying a variantOf field are alternate PARAMETER SETTINGS of the row they name, measured to expose a resource frontier. They are the same block. EXCLUDE them from any total.
Nothing here is a programmed device. This is not hardware proof.
